message.EngText: Members of the public are advised that, the traffic within Wo Hop Shek Cemetery and in its vicinity (including Tai Wo Service Road West, Wah Ming Road, Wo Hing Road and Pak Wo Road, etc.) is expected to be busier on the weekends after completion of the special traffic arrangements for Chung Yeung Festival. message.EngText:
As informed by the Chinese Mainland Railway Authorities, the following High Speed Rail train trips on 16 November 2026 will be cancelled due to traffic control :
From Hong Kong West Kowloon Station to Guangzhounan Station: G6536, G6526, G6584
From Guangzhounan Station to Hong Kong West Kowloon Station: G6535, G6537, G6583
For the latest train schedules, please refer to the official website (12306.cn) or the mobile app. You may also check the latest service updates on the HSR website, mobile app or see the information available at Hong Kong West Kowloon Station.
For ticket refunds, please refer to the information on the High Speed Rail website and process within the stated time. To obtain a refund, please use the 12306 official website (12306.cn) or mobile app. Unless you require assistance, there is no need to go to Hong Kong West Kowloon Station.
